description.value:
Frequency once per day

You overclock your core and its movement subroutines to move so fast that everything else seems to slow down. For 1 minute, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds, and you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Quickened]. You can use the extra action each round only to Stride.

Special If you have the Light Hop feat, you can use the extra action gained from Fast Forward to Light Hop or Stride; when you Light Hop in this way, it doesn't count toward Light Hop's frequency.
